szoveg_eredeti:
Four years ago Yourcast was #10 of the day here. Tomorrow comes 2.0: AI summaries with timestamps you can tap to jump in the audio, questions about any episode, feeds that fix themselves, files up to 2 GB.

If you still have it in Telegram, what's the one thing you'd change? I'll read every reply before the launch.

Hi Product Hunt 👋 I'm Konstantin, the maker of Yourcast.

I listen to podcasts on the go and live in Telegram, so I wanted new episodes to just arrive there.

It's for people who live in Telegram and don't want one more app just for podcasts.

Yourcast was #10 of the day here 4 years ago. After that it mostly ran on its own. In the last 7 weeks it changed more than in the 5 years before: 85 merged pull requests (~170 commits, against 55 in those 5 years), written mostly with LLM.

• AI summaries: the gist and key points with timestamps. Tap a time and the audio jumps there. Then ask anything about the episode.

• Tap a popular show to subscribe, and its latest episode arrives right away. Paste an Apple Podcasts link, or move from another app with an OPML file.

• Feeds that fix themselves: a broken or moved feed is rechecked daily and its new address found.

• Episodes up to 2 GB, downloads that resume where they stopped.

• Plans in Telegram Stars: free 10 episodes a week, Bronze $1 with automatic delivery, Relay $5 with 30 hours of summaries a month.

It's open source (GPL v3), PRs welcome: github.com/amadevstudio/yourcastbot

1. Is a summary enough to decide whether an episode is worth your hour?

2. What, if anything, stopped you in the first minute?

3. What would make you move from your current podcast app?

Weboldal: https://t.me/yourcastbot
